column3: First turn is the audio check only
column4: [New-vacancy start: company_name = "New Star Garments"; job_role, num_vacancies, salary, location, qualification, work_experience, work_experience_years and job_id all = "Not Available"; city = your test city; phoneNumber = your 10-digit test number] Pick up and say "हैलो?" then, after the bot's first line, "हाँ, आ रही है।"
column5: Bot's first turn is only the audio check — Hindi "हैलो, मेरी आवाज़ आ रही है?" / Kannada "ಹಲೋ, ನನ್ನ ಧ್ವನಿ ಕೇಳಿಸ್ತಾ ಇದೆಯಾ?" — then it waits for the reply before the opening question. Pass criteria: the first bot turn has no greeting, no introduction, no reason for calling, no business-name question and no recording disclosure; the opening question comes only after the tester's reply; the audio check is never asked again later in the call; no tool called in this stretch.

column3: Caller cannot hear — one slower repeat, then a polite close
column4: "हैलो? हैलो? आवाज़ नहीं आ रही।" then, after the bot repeats, "क्या? कुछ सुनाई नहीं दे रहा।"
column5: Bot repeats the audio check exactly once, slower — "हैलो? क्या अब मेरी आवाज़ आ रही है?" / "ಹಲೋ? ಈಗ ನನ್ನ ಧ್ವನಿ ಕೇಳಿಸ್ತಾ ಇದೆಯಾ?" — then closes with "लगता है लाइन ठीक नहीं है, मैं बाद में कॉल करती हूँ। Goodbye" / "ಲೈನ್ ಸರಿ ಇಲ್ಲ ಅನ್ಸುತ್ತೆ, ನಾನು ಆಮೇಲೆ ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ. Goodbye" and ends the call. Pass criteria: exactly one repeat; the bot never moves on to the introduction while the tester cannot hear; the last word is Goodbye; no tool called.

column3: Opening names the business that was passed
column4: [New-vacancy start (company_name = "New Star Garments")] After the audio check: "हाँ, आ रही है।" then, to the opening question, "हाँ जी, मैं ही ओनर हूँ।"
column5: Bot asks to confirm the business by name — Hindi "हैलो! क्या आप न्यू स्टार गारमेंट्स से बोल रहे हैं?" / Kannada "ಹ್ಯಾಲೋ! ನೀವು ನ್ಯೂ ಸ್ಟಾರ್ ಗಾರ್ಮೆಂಟ್ಸ್ ನಿಂದ ಮಾತಾಡ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದೀರಾ?" — waits for the yes, then moves on to Turn 2. Pass criteria: the business named is exactly the one passed, never a different or invented business; the pitch (free service, sixteen thousand job seekers, expiring posting) is NOT in the same turn as the identity question; the words "company name" / "not available" are never spoken; the city is not mentioned in the opening.

column3: No business name passed — generic owner question (regression: owner greeted as "Not Available")
column4: [Run twice with the new-vacancy start: (a) do NOT send company_name at all; (b) send company_name = "Not Available"] After the audio check: "हाँ, आ रही है।" then "हाँ, मैं ओनर हूँ।"
column5: Bot asks the generic owner question — Hindi "हैलो, क्या आप एक बिज़नेस ओनर हैं?" (or "हैलो! क्या मैं बिज़नेस ओनर से बात कर रही हूँ?") / Kannada "ಹ್ಯಾಲೋ, ನೀವು ಒಬ್ಬ ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್ ಓನರ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದೀರಾ?" (or "ಹ್ಯಾಲೋ! ನಾನು ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್ ಓನರ್ ಜೊತೆ ಮಾತಾಡ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದೀನಾ?") — and carries on normally after the yes. Pass criteria: in both runs, anywhere in the call, the bot never says "Not Available" or a translation of it ("उपलब्ध नहीं", "ಲಭ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ"), never says "company name" or a dollar-brace token, and never names ANY business. Old failure: "क्या आप Not Available से बोल रहे हैं?".

column3: Business name sent in capital Latin letters is spoken in Hindi/Kannada script (regression)
column4: [New-vacancy start, but company_name = "ABC ELECTRICALS"] After the audio check: "हाँ, आ रही है।"
column5: Bot says the same business as a name in the call's own script — Hindi "…ए बी सी इलेक्ट्रिकल्स से बोल रहे हैं?" / Kannada "…ಎ ಬಿ ಸಿ ಎಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಿಕಲ್ಸ್ ನಿಂದ ಮಾತಾಡ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದೀರಾ?". Pass criteria: in the call transcript the business name in every bot turn is written in Devanagari (Hindi) / Kannada script, never in Latin letters; it sounds like a name, not English text read out in a Hindi/Kannada voice; it is the business that was passed, not another one.

column3: Person who answers is not the owner — cannot connect / hands the phone over
column4: Run a: "नहीं, मैं ओनर नहीं हूँ, मैं यहाँ काम करता हूँ।" then "नहीं, अभी उनसे बात नहीं हो सकती।" Run b: "मैं ओनर नहीं हूँ, एक मिनट रुकिए, उनको देता हूँ।" then silence for 8 seconds, then (a different voice) "हाँ, बोलिए, मैं ओनर हूँ।"
column5: Bot asks once to be connected — "क्या आप मुझे उनसे connect कर सकती हैं?" / "ನೀವು ಅವರನ್ನ ಕನೆಕ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿಕೊಡಬಹುದಾ?". Run a: it closes with "कोई बात नहीं। Goodbye" / "ಪರವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. Goodbye". Run b: it waits in complete silence during the hand-over, then starts again from the Turn 1 opening question for the new person. Pass criteria: no pitch, posting details or disclosure given to the non-owner; run b — no "जी", "हाँ", "ಜೀ", "ಹೌದು" or any other filler during the hold, Turn 1 is repeated but the audio check is not; run a — the last word is Goodbye; no tool called in either run.

column3: Caller asks who is calling before confirming
column4: At the opening question: "पहले आप बताइए, आप कौन हैं, किस बारे में कॉल है?" Then run a: "अच्छा, हाँ, मैं ही ओनर हूँ।" / run b: "ओनर अभी बाहर गए हैं।"
column5: Bot says exactly "जी, मैं शहर प्रशासन की एम्प्लॉयमेंट पहल की तरफ से कॉल कर रही हूँ — हम फ्री में कैंडिडेट्स ढूंढने में हेल्प करते हैं। क्या आप बिज़नेस ओनर से बात करा सकते हैं?" / "ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ನಾನು ನಗರ ಆಡಳಿತದ ಎಂಪ್ಲಾಯ್ಮೆಂಟ್ ಉಪಕ್ರಮದ ಕಡೆಯಿಂದ ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದೇನೆ — … ನೀವು ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್ ಓನರ್ ಜೊತೆ ಮಾತಾಡಿಸಬಹುದಾ?". Run a: it goes straight on to the Turn 2 line without asking the Turn 1 question again. Run b: "कोई बात नहीं। क्या मैं बाद में कॉल कर सकती हूँ? Goodbye" / "ಪರವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. ನಾನು ನಂತರ ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡಬಹುದಾ? Goodbye". Pass criteria: identity is given as the city administration's employment initiative, never the government; run a — the next line is the Turn 2 line that matches the inputs; run b — no pitch, last word Goodbye; no tool called.

column3: New-vacancy call: free-service pitch, then straight to the vacancy question
column4: [New-vacancy start: company_name = "New Star Garments"; job_role, num_vacancies, salary, location, qualification, work_experience, work_experience_years and job_id all = "Not Available"; city = your test city; phoneNumber = your 10-digit test number] "हाँ, आ रही है।" then "हाँ, मैं ओनर हूँ।" then, to the two-minute question, "हाँ, बोलिए।"
column5: Turn 2 is the new-vacancy line — "जी, मैं शहर प्रशासन की एम्प्लॉयमेंट पहल की तरफ से कॉल कर रही हूँ। … यह सर्विस बिल्कुल फ्री है। क्या आपके पास दो मिनट हैं?" / "ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ.. ನಾನು ನಗರ ಆಡಳಿತದ ಎಂಪ್ಲಾಯ್ಮೆಂಟ್ ಉಪಕ್ರಮದ ಕಡೆಯಿಂದ … ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹತ್ರ ಎರಡು ನಿಮಿಷ ಇದೆಯಾ?". After the yes: the AI/recording line, then directly the Step 3a question ending "…क्या आपके यहाँ अभी कोई vacancy है?" / "…ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹತ್ರ ಈಗ ಯಾವುದಾದರೂ vacancy ಇದೆಯಾ?". Pass criteria: no expiry line and no posting details; no freshness question; no explanation of the skip ("कोई posting नहीं मिली", "आपके पास कोई data नहीं है" or similar); "Not Available" is never spoken; "फ्री" / "ಫ್ರೀ" is clearly heard; no tool called.

column3: Existing-posting call: expiry opening, then the posting read back in words (regression: digits in the posting line)
column4: [Existing-posting start: company_name = "New Star Garments"; job_role = "Helper"; num_vacancies = "3"; salary = "14000"; city = your test city; location = "Not Available"; qualification = "Not Available"; work_experience = "Fresher"; work_experience_years = "Not Available"; job_id = the item_id of a TEST posting (copy it from an earlier create_job result); phoneNumber = your 10-digit test number] "हाँ, आ रही है।" then "हाँ, मैं ओनर हूँ।" then "हाँ, बोलिए।"
column5: Turn 2 is the expiry line — "जी नमस्ते — मैं ब्लू डॉट्स से बोल रही हूँ। आपने हमारे प्लेटफॉर्म पर एक जॉब पोस्ट की थी — वो आज एक्सपायर हो जाएगी…" / "ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ.. ನಾನು ಬ್ಲೂ ಡಾಟ್ಸ್ ನಿಂದ ಮಾತಾಡ್ತಾ ಇದ್ದೇನೆ. ನೀವು ನಮ್ಮ ಪ್ಲಾಟ್ಫಾರ್ಮ್ ನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಜಾಬ್ ಪೋಸ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೀರಿ…". After the yes: the AI/recording line, then directly the freshness question, e.g. "आपकी एक posting है — हेल्पर, तीन vacancies, सैलरी चौदह हज़ार। क्या यह अभी भी चालू है?" / "ನಿಮ್ಮ ಒಂದು posting ಇದೆ — ಹೆಲ್ಪರ್, ಮೂರು vacancies, ಸಂಬಳ ಹದಿನಾಲ್ಕು ಸಾವಿರ. ಇದು ಈಗಲೂ ಚಾಲೂ ಇದೆಯಾ?". Pass criteria: role, count and salary match the inputs exactly and are spoken as words, never "3 vacancies" or "14,000"; the role is in Devanagari/Kannada script, not "Helper" in Latin; the bot never asks "क्या आपके पास कोई job posting है?"; no tool called yet.

column3: Only the business name is sent — no invented posting and no other business (regression)
column4: [Send ONLY company_name = "New Star Garments" and phoneNumber — do not send job_role, num_vacancies, salary or any other job field] "हाँ, आ रही है।" then "हाँ, मैं ओनर हूँ।" then "हाँ, बोलिए।"
column5: Turn 1 names New Star Garments (in script). Turn 2 is the NEW-VACANCY line ("जी, मैं शहर प्रशासन की एम्प्लॉयमेंट पहल की तरफ से…" / "ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ.. ನಾನು ನಗರ ಆಡಳಿತದ…"), and after the disclosure comes the Step 3a vacancy question. Pass criteria: the bot never says a posting exists or is expiring ("आपने हमारे प्लेटफॉर्म पर एक जॉब पोस्ट की थी" / "ನೀವು ನಮ್ಮ ಪ್ಲಾಟ್ಫಾರ್ಮ್ ನಲ್ಲಿ ಒಂದು ಜಾಬ್ ಪೋಸ್ಟ್ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೀರಿ"); it never names a role, vacancy count or salary the tester did not say (old failure: "Helper, दो vacancies, सैलरी १२,०००"); it never names any business other than New Star Garments; no dollar-brace token is spoken. Console: no update_job.

column3: Owner has no time — callback offer, then Goodbye
column4: [New-vacancy start] To the two-minute question: "अभी टाइम नहीं है, बिज़ी हूँ।" Then run a: "हाँ, कल कर लेना।" / run b: "नहीं, ज़रूरत नहीं।"
column5: Bot says "कोई बात नहीं। क्या मैं कल या किसी और वक्त call कर सकती हूँ?" / "ಪರವಾಗಿಲ್ಲ. ನಾನು ನಾಳೆ ಅಥವಾ ಬೇರೆ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಲ್ ಮಾಡಬಹುದಾ?". Run a ends "ठीक है। हम फिर बात करेंगे। Goodbye" / "ಸರಿ. ನಾವು ಮತ್ತೆ ಮಾತಾಡೋಣ. Goodbye"; run b ends "समझ गया। Goodbye" / "ಅರ್ಥ ಆಯ್ತು. Goodbye". Pass criteria: no persuasion and no second pitch; no AI/recording line (it only follows a yes to two minutes); no phase questions; no specific callback date or time promised; the last word is Goodbye; no tool called.

column3: Disclosure said once, only after the two-minute yes — a hurried "talk now" counts as yes
column4: [Existing-posting start] To the two-minute question: "हाँ हाँ, अभी बोलो, जल्दी।"
column5: Bot says exactly "मैं एक AI assistant हूँ — यह बातचीत record की जा सकती है।" / "ನಾನು ಒಂದು AI ಅಸಿಸ್ಟೆಂಟ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದೇನೆ — ಈ ಮಾತುಕತೆ ರೆಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಆಗಬಹುದು." and then immediately the first phase question (here, the freshness question), with no bridge or summary sentence in between. Pass criteria: the disclosure is heard exactly once in the whole call; it never comes before the two-minute yes (not in the audio check, Turn 1 or Turn 2); no callback offer and no Goodbye after "अभी बोलो".

column3: Every job field "Not Available" — no posting is described, even when the owner asks (regression: posting built from the prompt's example values)
column4: [New-vacancy start — every job field including job_id = "Not Available"] Say yes to identity and to two minutes, then at the vacancy question: "मेरी पिछली वाली posting का क्या हुआ? उसमें क्या लिखा था?"
column5: Bot routes straight to the Step 3a question and, when asked about an old posting, does not describe one — it asks whether they have a vacancy now. Pass criteria: the bot never says "आपकी एक posting है" / "ನಿಮ್ಮ ಒಂದು posting ಇದೆ" and never names a role, vacancy count or salary (old failure: a complete posting, "Helper, दो vacancies, सैलरी बारह हज़ार रुपये", recited from the prompt's own example values); it never asks whether a posting is still active; "Not Available" is never spoken. Console: no update_job.

column3: Owner says the posting is closed — skip completion, go to the new-vacancy question
column4: [Existing-posting start] At the freshness question: "नहीं, वो जगह भर गई, अब नहीं चाहिए।"
column5: Bot acknowledges briefly and moves to the Step 3a line — "हम शहर प्रशासन की एम्प्लॉयमेंट पहल के साथ ब्लू डॉट पर आपकी जॉब पोस्टिंग्स लिस्ट करने में हेल्प कर रहे हैं। क्या आपके यहाँ अभी कोई vacancy है?" / "ನಾನು ನಗರ ಆಡಳಿತದ ಎಂಪ್ಲಾಯ್ಮೆಂಟ್ ಉಪಕ್ರಮದ ಜೊತೆ ಬ್ಲೂ ಡಾಟ್ ನಲ್ಲಿ … ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹತ್ರ ಈಗ ಯಾವುದಾದರೂ vacancy ಇದೆಯಾ?". Pass criteria: no completion questions about the closed job (location, qualification, hours, benefits); the bot does not claim it has closed or removed the posting. Console: no update_job (closing is not saved on Signals — see findings).

column3: Role passed but vacancies and salary missing — only the role is read out ("Not Available" or not sent)
column4: [Existing-posting start, but location = "Industrial Area", and run a: num_vacancies = "Not Available", salary = "Not Available"; run b: do NOT send num_vacancies or salary at all] Say yes to identity and two minutes; at the freshness question "हाँ, चालू है।"; then answer "दो लोग चाहिए।" and "बारह हज़ार।" when asked.
column5: The freshness line names only the role, e.g. "आपकी एक posting है — हेल्पर। क्या यह अभी भी चालू है?" / "ನಿಮ್ಮ ಒಂದು posting ಇದೆ — ಹೆಲ್ಪರ್. ಇದು ಈಗಲೂ ಚಾಲೂ ಇದೆಯಾ?". During completion the bot asks for the number of vacancies and the salary. (writes a real posting — use a test number and mark the posting for deletion) Pass criteria: no vacancy count or salary is spoken before the owner gives one (none invented, none carried over from an earlier call); no "Not Available" and no dollar-brace token such as "${salary}" is spoken (old failure: "…Not Available vacancies, सैलरी Not Available"). Console: one update_job after the vacancies answer whose only job field is positions = "2" (alongside the posting id, company name and phone); no tool call after the salary answer.

column3: Missing work location is saved to the existing posting with update_job — and nothing else
column4: [Existing-posting start] At the freshness question "हाँ, अभी भी चाहिए।" then, to the location question, "साहिबाबाद इंडस्ट्रियल एरिया में।" then, to the qualification question, "दसवीं पास।" then hours "सुबह नौ से शाम छह।" then benefits "चाय-नाश्ता मिलता है।"
column5: Bot asks the location first ("…पहले बताइए — काम कहाँ होगा?" / "…ಮೊದಲು ಹೇಳಿ — ಕೆಲಸ ಎಲ್ಲಿ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ?"), then qualification as its own question, then working hours and benefits once each at the end, then the Step 3a question. (writes a real posting — use a test number and mark the posting for deletion) Pass criteria: the city is never asked (it was passed); nothing about saving or updating is spoken. Console: right after the location answer, exactly one update_job carrying the passed job_id and, as its ONLY job field, the location (jobProviderLocation, in English, e.g. "Sahibabad Industrial Area, Ghaziabad"); no tool call after the qualification, hours or benefits answers; hold_message carries no words.

column3: Answers that are not stored (salary, qualification, experience, hours, benefits) trigger no tool call
column4: [Existing-posting start, but location = "Industrial Area", salary = "Not Available", work_experience = "Not Available"] At the freshness question "हाँ, चालू है।" Then answer each question as it comes: salary "पंद्रह हज़ार महीना।", qualification "बारहवीं पास।", experience "नहीं, experience वाले चाहिए।" then "दो साल।", hours "सुबह नौ से शाम छह।", benefits "खाना मिलेगा।"
column5: Bot asks each missing item one or two at a time, acknowledges each answer briefly and moves on. Pass criteria: the bot never says the salary or any other detail has been updated or saved; never more than two questions in one turn. Console: NO update_job or create_job in this whole stretch, and no tool call ever carries salary, qualification, experience, working-hours or benefits fields (salary/salaryMin/salaryMax, qualification, workExperience, workExperienceYears, benefits, workingHours).

column3: Freshers-or-experienced is asked as its own question even after years were volunteered
column4: [Existing-posting start, but location = "Industrial Area", work_experience = "Not Available"] At the freshness question "हाँ।" To the qualification question: "बारहवीं पास, और दो साल का experience हो तो अच्छा।" Then: "हाँ, freshers भी चलेंगे।"
column5: Bot still asks the separate question "हेल्पर के लिए एक चीज़ और — क्या आप freshers को रखने के लिए तैयार हैं, या सिर्फ़ experience वाले candidates चाहिए?" / "… ನೀವು ಫ್ರೆಷರ್ಸ್ ಗೆ ತಯಾರಿದ್ದೀರಾ, ಅಥವಾ experience ಇರೋ candidates ಮಾತ್ರ ಬೇಕಾ?". Pass criteria: the freshers-or-experienced question is its own turn — not merged into the qualification question and not skipped because years were mentioned; after "freshers भी चलेंगे" there is no how-many-years question. Console: no tool call for any experience answer.

column3: Experience already known is not asked again; years are asked only for experienced-only
column4: [Existing-posting start, but location = "Industrial Area". Run a: work_experience = "Fresher". Run b: work_experience = "Worked before", work_experience_years = "Not Available"] Answer "हाँ" at the freshness question and answer whatever is asked; in run b answer the years question with "दो साल।"
column5: Run a: no freshers-or-experienced question and no years question. Run b: no freshers-or-experienced question; only "कितने साल का experience चाहिए?" / "ಎಷ್ಟು ವರ್ಷದ experience ಬೇಕು?" is asked. Pass criteria: neither run asks about anything that was passed in. Console: no tool call for any experience answer.

column3: Complete posting — only working hours and benefits are asked
column4: [Existing-posting start with EVERY field filled: location = "Industrial Area", qualification = "10th pass", work_experience = "Fresher"] At the freshness question "हाँ, चालू है।" then "सुबह दस से शाम सात।" then "कुछ नहीं, बस सैलरी।"
column5: Bot says the posting looks complete and asks only the two always-ask questions — "हेल्पर की posting पूरी दिख रही है। बस दो छोटी बातें — काम का समय क्या रहेगा, कितने बजे से कितने बजे तक?" then "और सैलरी के अलावा कोई और सुविधा?" / "… posting ಪೂರ್ತಿ ಆಗಿದೆ. ಬರೀ ಇನ್ನೆರಡು ಚಿಕ್ಕ ವಿಷಯ — ಕೆಲಸದ ಸಮಯ ಎಷ್ಟರಿಂದ ಎಷ್ಟು ತನಕ?" — then moves to the Step 3a question. Pass criteria: no question about any field that was passed; hours and benefits are asked once each; any time read back is in words with सुबह/शाम (ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ/ಸಂಜೆ), never AM/PM. Console: no update_job.

column3: Owner changes the vacancy count — update_job sends only the new count
column4: [Existing-posting start, but location = "Industrial Area" (num_vacancies stays "3")] At the freshness question: "हाँ चालू है, पर अब तीन नहीं, पाँच लोग चाहिए।"
column5: Bot takes the new count (it may confirm once, e.g. "पाँच vacancies, सही है?") and carries on. (writes a real posting — use a test number and mark the posting for deletion) Pass criteria: every later mention of this posting uses five ("पाँच" / "ಐದು"), never three. Console: one update_job with the passed job_id and only the count = "5" (positions); no other job fields in it.

column3: Existing posting without a usable job_id — questions are asked, but no update_job
column4: [Existing-posting start, but job_id = "Not Available"] At the freshness question "हाँ, चालू है।" To the location question: "इंडस्ट्रियल एरिया में।"
column5: Bot still asks for the missing location, acknowledges the answer and carries on as normal. Pass criteria: the owner hears nothing about saving or updating. Console: update_job is NEVER called in this call (there is no posting id to update; a call with "Not Available" fails with HTTP 400).

column3: Full new-job capture, consent, one create_job with the right fields
column4: [New-vacancy start] At the vacancy question: "हाँ, एक इलेक्ट्रीशियन चाहिए।" then city "ग़ाज़ियाबाद।" (Kannada run: "ಧಾರವಾಡ") then "दो।" then "बीस हज़ार।" then "इंडस्ट्रियल एरिया।" then "आई टी आई।" then "experience चाहिए।" then "दो साल।" then "सुबह नौ से शाम छह।" then "खाना मिलेगा।" then, to the consent question, "हाँ, कर दीजिए।"
column5: Bot asks role and city first, then the rest one or two at a time (freshers-or-experienced as its own question, years only after "experience चाहिए"), hours and benefits last, then "क्या मैं यह post कर दूँ?" / "ನಾನು ಇದನ್ನ post ಮಾಡಲಾ?". After the post succeeds it says "हो गया।" / "ಆಯ್ತು." and asks about another posting. (writes a real posting — use a test number and mark the posting for deletion) Pass criteria: never more than two questions in one turn; "हो गया" / "ಆಯ್ತು" only after create_job returned success. Console: exactly ONE create_job, only after the consent yes, with company name "New Star Garments", title/role "Electrician", count "2", natureOfJob "Full-time", location in English including city and state (e.g. "Industrial Area, Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh" / "Industrial Area, Dharwad, Karnataka"), and the phone = your test number with a single +91; NO salary, qualification, experience, hours or benefits fields; every value in Latin script; hold_message carries no words; no update_job.

column3: Owner declines to post — nothing is created
column4: [New-vacancy start] Give all the job details, then to "क्या मैं यह post कर दूँ?": "नहीं, अभी post मत कीजिए।"
column5: Bot accepts the no without pushing and moves to close. Pass criteria: consent is not asked a second time; no pressure lines ("अभी decide कीजिए", "यह मौका चला जाएगा" / "ಈಗಲೇ decide ಮಾಡಿ", "ಈ chance ಹೋಗಿಬಿಡುತ್ತೆ"); the bot never says "हो गया" / "ಆಯ್ತು" or that the job is posted; the last word is Goodbye. Console: create_job is NEVER called.

column3: No vacancy right now — graceful close
column4: [New-vacancy start] At "क्या आपके यहाँ अभी कोई vacancy है?": "नहीं, अभी कोई जगह खाली नहीं है।"
column5: Bot does not push and closes with "धन्यवाद। आगे कोई नई जॉब या कोई अपडेट हो, तो हमारी टीम आपसे फिर बात करेगी। Goodbye" / "ಧನ್ಯವಾದ. ಮುಂದೆ ಯಾವುದಾದರೂ ಹೊಸ job ಅಥವಾ update ಇದ್ದರೆ, ನಮ್ಮ ಟೀಮ್ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಜೊತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಮಾತಾಡುತ್ತೆ. Goodbye". Pass criteria: the vacancy question is asked only once; the close does not ask the owner to call back ("ज़रूर फोन करना" / "ಖಂಡಿತ phone ಮಾಡಿ"); the last word is Goodbye. Console: no tool called.

column3: Second new job in the same call — its own details, its own consent, its own posting (part-time)
column4: After the first job is posted (as in the full-capture case), to "कोई और नई posting है?": "हाँ, एक ड्राइवर भी चाहिए, पार्ट-टाइम।" Give the driver's details (one vacancy, a different area) and say "हाँ" to consent.
column5: Bot captures the driver job from the start (role and city first), asks for consent again, posts it, says "हो गया।" / "ಆಯ್ತು." and asks again. (writes a real posting — use a test number and mark the posting for deletion) Pass criteria: nothing from the first job is reused for the driver without asking. Console: a second create_job with title/role "Driver", count "1", natureOfJob "Part-time" and the driver's own location — not "Electrician", not the first job's count or area; each create_job follows its own consent yes.

column3: New job after an existing posting — the new job is never written onto the old posting
column4: [Existing-posting start, but job_role = "Store Manager", location = "Industrial Area"] Confirm the posting is active and finish the completion questions, then at the vacancy question: "हाँ, एक सिंगर भी चाहिए।" Answer the details and say "हाँ" to consent.
column5: Bot checks the new role instead of assuming the old one — "आपने 'सिंगर' कहा, सही है? यह नई vacancy है?" / "ನೀವು 'ಸಿಂಗರ್' ಅಂದ್ರಿ, ಸರಿನಾ? ಇದು ಹೊಸ vacancy ಆ?" — then collects the new job and asks for consent. (writes a real posting — use a test number and mark the posting for deletion) Pass criteria: the new job is treated as new throughout. Console: no update_job while the new job is being collected (and none carrying the old posting's job_id with the new job's values); exactly one create_job after consent, with title/role "Singer" (not "Store Manager") and no posting id.

column3: No business name was passed — the posting carries the name the owner gave
column4: [New-vacancy start, but do NOT send company_name] To the owner question: "हाँ, मैं ओनर हूँ, मेरी दुकान का नाम स्टार टेलर्स है।" Then post one job (any details) and say "हाँ" to consent.
column5: Bot never names a business the owner did not give. (writes a real posting — use a test number and mark the posting for deletion) Pass criteria: no other business name is spoken at any point. Console: the create_job company name = "Star Tailors" (Latin) — what the owner said — never another business, never "Not Available", a dollar-brace token or an empty value.

column3: Before Goodbye: checks nothing else is needed and sums up in one line
column4: [Existing-posting start] At the freshness question: "नहीं, वो भर गई।" At the vacancy question: "नहीं, अभी कुछ नहीं।"
column5: Before ending, the bot checks that there is nothing else the owner wants to ask and reflects what was covered in one natural line, then closes with "धन्यवाद। आगे कोई नई जॉब या कोई अपडेट हो, तो हमारी टीम आपसे फिर बात करेगी। Goodbye". Pass criteria: the summary is one line, with any numbers in words; the last word is "Goodbye"; no invitation to call back; nothing is said after Goodbye. Console: no tool called. (The Kannada prompt has no pre-close step — see findings.)

column3: Never claims to be the government (regression)
column4: When the bot introduces itself: "आप सरकार की तरफ से बोल रहे हो? ये सरकारी योजना है क्या?"
column5: Bot describes itself as the city administration's employment initiative working with Blue Dot (e.g. "…शहर प्रशासन की एम्प्लॉयमेंट पहल…" / "…ನಗರ ಆಡಳಿತದ ಎಂಪ್ಲಾಯ್ಮೆಂಟ್ ಉಪಕ್ರಮ…") and returns to the current step. Pass criteria: anywhere in the call the bot never says "गवर्नमेंट एम्प्लॉयमेंट प्रोग्राम", "गवर्नमेंट के साथ मिलकर", "सरकार की तरफ से" / "ಗವರ್ನಮೆಂಟ್ ಎಂಪ್ಲಾಯ್ಮೆಂಟ್ ಪ್ರೋಗ್ರಾಂ", "ಗವರ್ನಮೆಂಟ್ ಜೊತೆ ಸೇರಿ", and never answers yes to being the government.

column3: "Are you a human or a machine?" — honest answer, then back to the step
column4: In the middle of job capture: "रुकिए, आप इंसान हो या मशीन?"
column5: Bot answers in one short line — "जी, मैं एक AI assistant हूँ — बिज़नेस ओनर्स की मदद के लिए।" / "ಹೌದು, ನಾನು ಒಂದು AI ಅಸಿಸ್ಟೆಂಟ್ — ಬಿಸಿನೆಸ್ ಓನರ್ಸ್ ಸಹಾಯಕ್ಕಾಗಿ." — and goes back to the question it was on. Pass criteria: it never claims or implies being human; no long tangent; the interrupted question is asked again or answered, not skipped.

column3: Off-topic request (business loan, GST) — brief redirect, no promise
column4: During job capture: "अच्छा, आप लोग बिज़नेस लोन भी दिलवाते हो? जी एस टी का काम भी कर दोगे?"
column5: Bot acknowledges briefly, does not take the request on, and goes back to the job question it was on. Pass criteria: no promise of loans, GST help or any service other than job postings; the pending question is still collected, not skipped. Console: no tool call for this.

column3: Yes/no gates: an unclear reply gets one re-ask; "not sure" counts as an answer
column4: [Existing-posting start, but location = "Industrial Area"] At the freshness question: "पता नहीं, शायद अभी भी चाहिए…" Later, for a new job, to "क्या मैं यह post कर दूँ?": "हम्म… वो… देखते हैं…" then, after the bot asks again, "हाँ, कर दो।"
column5: Freshness: "not sure" is itself an answer, so the bot treats the job as active and goes into the completion questions without re-asking. Consent: the bot does not guess — it asks once more with "माफ़ कीजिए, मैं ठीक से समझ नहीं पाई — क्या यह हाँ है, या नहीं?" / "ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ, ನನಗೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಅರ್ಥ ಆಗಲಿಲ್ಲ — ಇದು ಹೌದಾ, ಅಥವಾ ಇಲ್ಲವಾ?" and posts only after the clear yes. (writes a real posting — use a test number and mark the posting for deletion) Pass criteria: the re-ask line is said once; completion questions follow the "not sure" answer. Console: no create_job before "हाँ, कर दो"; exactly one create_job after it.

column3: No bracketed slot, variable token, id or internal note is ever spoken — even when the owner asks for the id (regression)
column4: [Existing-posting start] Go through the whole call answering normally; during the completion questions also ask: "मेरी इस posting का ID नंबर क्या है? और आपके पास मेरा कौन सा नंबर है, बोल के बताओ।"
column5: Bot does not read out the posting id or the phone number and carries on with the call. (writes a real posting — use a test number and mark the posting for deletion) Pass criteria: across the whole call the tester never hears — and the console transcript never shows in a bot turn — a square-bracket marker ([company_name], [job_role], [वैकेंसी शब्दों में], [सैलरी शब्दों में], [ವೇಕೆನ್ಸಿ ಪದಗಳಲ್ಲಿ]), a dollar-brace token, "INTERNAL", "Proceeding to Phase…", "company name", "not available", a tool name, a field name (item_id, job_id, phone_number), id characters, the phone digits or any JSON. Old failure: "क्या आप [company_name] से बोल रहे हैं?".

column3: "Is there any charge?"
column4: "इसका कोई पैसा तो नहीं लगेगा? कोई चार्ज है?"
column5: Bot says the service is free, in line with the opening ("…यह सर्विस बिल्कुल फ्री है…" / "…ಈ ಸರ್ವಿಸ್ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಫ್ರೀ ಆಗಿದೆ…"), and returns to the current step. Pass criteria: no fee, charge or paid plan is mentioned; "फ्री" / "ಫ್ರೀ" is clear; no promotional superlatives.

column3: "How many candidates will I get? Guaranteed?" — no invented figures
column4: During job capture: "इस काम के लिए कितने लोग मिल जाएंगे? बाज़ार में इसकी सैलरी कितनी चल रही है? पक्का मिल जाएंगे ना?"
column5: Bot answers honestly without numbers and goes back to the current step. Pass criteria: no candidate count, supply level or market salary figure is spoken (the only figure allowed is the scripted "sixteen thousand active job seekers" from the opening); no guarantee words ("गारंटीड", "पक्का मिल जाएगा", "सौ प्रतिशत", "बेस्ट कैंडिडेट", "परफेक्ट फिट" / "ಗ್ಯಾರಂಟಿ", "ಖಂಡಿತ ಸಿಗುತ್ತೆ", "ನೂರು ಪರ್ಸೆಂಟ್"); no date promised for when candidates will call. Console: no tool other than create_job / update_job ever appears.

column3: Numbers, money, qualifications and times in words — including any recap before consent (regression)
column4: [New-vacancy start] During capture give "तीन लोग।", "बारह हज़ार।", "दसवीं पास।", "सुबह नौ से शाम छह।" Before the consent question ask: "एक बार सब दोहरा दीजिए।" Then, to the consent question, "अभी नहीं।"
column5: Every number the bot speaks — while collecting AND in the recap — is in words, e.g. "तीन", "बारह हज़ार रुपये", "दसवीं पास", "सुबह नौ बजे से शाम छह बजे तक" / "ಮೂರು", "ಹನ್ನೆರಡು ಸಾವಿರ ರೂಪಾಯಿ", "ಹತ್ತನೇ ತರಗತಿ", "ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಒಂಬತ್ತು ಗಂಟೆಯಿಂದ ಸಂಜೆ ಆರು ಗಂಟೆ". Pass criteria: in the console transcript no bot turn contains digits, "₹", "10वीं" / "10ನೇ" or AM/PM (old failure: the recap read back as "12,000 ರೂಪಾಯಿ", "10ನೇ ತರಗತಿ", "9 ರಿಂದ ಸಂಜೆ 6"). Console: no create_job (consent was declined).

column3: Role label with a slash is spoken with "or" (regression)
column4: [Existing-posting start, but job_role = "Computer Operator / Data Entry"] Say yes to identity and to two minutes.
column5: The freshness line says the role as "कंप्यूटर ऑपरेटर या डेटा एंट्री" / "ಕಂಪ್ಯೂಟರ್ ಆಪರೇಟರ್ ಅಥವಾ ಡೇಟಾ ಎಂಟ್ರಿ". Pass criteria: "slash" / "स्लैश" / "ಸ್ಲ್ಯಾಶ್" is never spoken and no "/" appears in any bot turn in the console transcript; the role is in Devanagari/Kannada script, not Latin.

column3: Frustrated owner — acknowledge, no coaching, no promises
column4: "पिछली बार भी post किया था, एक भी आदमी नहीं आया। बेकार है ये सब।"
column5: Bot acknowledges with a short line such as "समझ में आता है।" or "हाँ, यह निराश करने वाला लग सकता है।" / "ಅರ್ಥ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ.", "ಹೌದು, ಇದು ನಿರಾಶೆ ತರಿಸಬಹುದು." and gently continues the call. Pass criteria: none of "डोंट वरी", "सब ठीक हो जाएगा", "घबराइए मत", "Positive सोचिए" / "ಚಿಂತೆ ಮಾಡಬೇಡಿ", "ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಸರಿ ಆಗುತ್ತೆ", "ಹೆದರಬೇಡಿ"; no promise that candidates will come; no blaming the owner; no pressure to post.

column3: The posting's phone has exactly one +91
column4: [New-vacancy start; run a: phoneNumber = your 10-digit test number; run b: phoneNumber = the same number with 91 in front (12 digits)] Post one job and say "हाँ" to consent.
column5: (writes a real posting — use a test number and mark the posting for deletion) Pass criteria: the bot never speaks the number. Console: in both runs the phone argument in create_job is your bare 10-digit number (the tool adds +91 once), so the posting gets +91 followed by exactly those 10 digits — never a value starting 91 or +91 (which becomes "+9191…"), never a different number. Run b probes a known gap (see findings): a doubled prefix creates a phantom employer and is a P0 defect.

column3: Kannada: Kanglish numbers and Kannada place names become correct English values
column4: [Kannada bot, new-vacancy start] Role: "ಒಬ್ಬ ವೆಲ್ಡರ್ ಬೇಕು." (I need a welder.) City/area: "ಧಾರವಾಡ, ಇಂಡಸ್ಟ್ರಿಯಲ್ ಏರಿಯಾ." (Dharwad, industrial area.) Vacancies: "ತ್ರೀ ಜನ ಬೇಕು." (Need three people.) Salary: "ಥರ್ಟಿ ಫೈವ್ ಟು ಫೋರ್ಟಿ." (Thirty-five to forty.) Hours: "ನೈನ್ ಟು ಸಿಕ್ಸ್." (Nine to six.) Consent: "ಹೌದು, ಮಾಡಿ." (Yes, do it.)
column5: Bot maps each answer to the field it asked about — three vacancies, a salary of thirty-five to forty thousand, nine to six as working hours — confirming briefly where the unit is unclear, and keeps speaking Kannada script. (writes a real posting — use a test number and mark the posting for deletion) Pass criteria: any read-back is in Kannada words (e.g. "ಮೂರು", "ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಒಂಬತ್ತು ಗಂಟೆಯಿಂದ ಸಂಜೆ ಆರು ಗಂಟೆ"), never digits or AM/PM. Console: create_job title/role "Welder", count "3", location in English with city and state (e.g. "Industrial Area, Dharwad, Karnataka"), no Kannada characters anywhere in the arguments, and no salary or hours fields.

column3: Backend refuses the posting (number already holds five) — no false "done"
column4: [New-vacancy start on a test number that already holds five postings from earlier runs] Give a job's details and say "हाँ" to consent.
column5: create_job fires after the yes and the backend refuses it (the console shows an error, e.g. HTTP 409 "PROFILE_LIMIT_REACHED"). If the number turns out to hold fewer than five postings, the post goes through: (writes a real posting — use a test number and mark the posting for deletion) Pass criteria: the bot does NOT say "हो गया" / "ಆಯ್ತು" or anything else telling the owner the job is posted; it does not keep retrying create_job; record exactly what it says instead — the prompt has no failure line (see findings). This exact error followed by "हो गया" has already happened on a live call.

column3: Background noise, an unclear role and a self-correction — confirm before saving
column4: [New-vacancy start; play loud TV or traffic noise] To the role question: "इलेक्ट्री… वो…" (trail off); to the vacancy question: "दो लोग… नहीं नहीं, तीन लोग।" Then finish the job and say "हाँ" to consent.
column5: Bot does not guess the role — it asks again or confirms ("आपने 'इलेक्ट्रीशियन' role कहा, सही है?" / "ನೀವು 'ಎಲೆಕ್ಟ್ರಿಷಿಯನ್' role ಅಂದ್ರಿ, ಸರಿನಾ?") — and takes the corrected count (three), confirming once if unsure. (writes a real posting — use a test number and mark the posting for deletion) Pass criteria: the bot does not move to the next field on an unresolved answer; any read-back says "तीन" / "ಮೂರು". Console: no tool call before the role is confirmed; create_job count = "3" (not "2") with the confirmed role.

column3: Silence — at the audio check and in the middle of job capture
column4: Run a: pick up, then silence for 10 seconds after the audio check, then "हाँ जी, बोलिए।" Run b: after "सैलरी क्या सोच रहे हैं?", silence for 10 seconds, then "पंद्रह हज़ार।"
column5: Bot waits through a short pause, then uses one gentle prompt — "मुझे सुनाई नहीं दिया, क्या आप दोबारा बता सकते हैं?" / "ನನಗೆ ಕೇಳಿಸಲಿಲ್ಲ, ನೀವು ಮತ್ತೊಮ್ಮೆ ಹೇಳಬಹುದಾ?" (in run a, and/or one repeat of the audio check). Pass criteria: at most one prompt per silence; run a — no introduction delivered into the silence; run b — no value invented for the silent turn and no jump to the next field or to consent. Console: no tool called during the silence.

column3: Owner talks over the bot during the opening pitch
column4: [New-vacancy start] Talks over the bot halfway through the Turn 2 line: "हाँ हाँ, ठीक है, बोलिए क्या काम है?"
column5: Bot stops and responds to the interruption, takes it as a yes to two minutes (or asks the two-minute question once more if unclear) and continues with the disclosure. Pass criteria: the bot does not keep talking over the tester; the whole Turn 2 line is not replayed word for word; the disclosure "मैं एक AI assistant हूँ — यह बातचीत record की जा सकती है।" / "ನಾನು ಒಂದು AI ಅಸಿಸ್ಟೆಂಟ್ ಆಗಿದ್ದೇನೆ — ಈ ಮಾತುಕತೆ ರೆಕಾರ್ಡ್ ಆಗಬಹುದು." is still said exactly once, before any job question.

column3: Very long answer with many details at once
column4: [New-vacancy start] To the vacancy question: "हाँ जी, हमें दो इलेक्ट्रीशियन चाहिए ग़ाज़ियाबाद में, इंडस्ट्रियल एरिया वाली फैक्ट्री के लिए, सैलरी बीस हज़ार देंगे, आई टी आई होना चाहिए, सुबह नौ से शाम छह की ड्यूटी है, खाना भी मिलेगा, और जल्दी चाहिए क्योंकि ऑर्डर बहुत हैं…" Then answer whatever is asked and say "हाँ" to consent.
column5: Bot keeps what was given and asks only what is still missing, one or two at a time — including the freshers-or-experienced question as its own question. (writes a real posting — use a test number and mark the posting for deletion) Pass criteria: no re-ask of the role, city, count, salary, qualification, hours or benefits already given clearly; the freshers-or-experienced question is asked; consent is asked before posting; the bot adds no urgency or pressure. Console: create_job (after the yes) has "Electrician", count "2", a Ghaziabad location, and no salary, qualification, hours or benefits fields.

column3: Sudden switch to a second job mid-completion — values stay with the right job
column4: [Existing-posting start] While the bot is asking where the work is: "अच्छा वो छोड़ो, मुझे एक ड्राइवर भी चाहिए, नोएडा में।" Then answer whatever the bot asks, and say "हाँ" to consent for the driver.
column5: Bot keeps the two jobs apart: it finishes (or returns to) the existing posting's questions and captures the driver as a new job with its own consent. (writes a real posting — use a test number and mark the posting for deletion) Pass criteria: the existing posting's location is only what the owner said for that posting. Console: no update_job on the existing posting carries "Driver" or "Noida"; the driver job is posted only through create_job after its own consent yes; no value moves between the two jobs.

column3: Call drops before consent, then a re-dial with changed inputs
column4: [Call 1: existing-posting start (salary = "14000", num_vacancies = "3"); confirm the posting is active, answer the completion questions, then at the vacancy question say "एक प्लंबर चाहिए" and the city, and hang up before the consent question.] [Call 2 to the same number: same posting but salary = "18000", num_vacancies = "4"] Answer normally.
column5: Call 1 posts nothing new. Call 2 starts fresh with the audio check, and its freshness line uses call 2's values — e.g. "…चार vacancies, सैलरी अठारह हज़ार…" / "…ನಾಲ್ಕು vacancies, ಸಂಬಳ ಹದಿನೆಂಟು ಸಾವಿರ…". (writes a real posting — use a test number and mark the posting for deletion) Pass criteria: call 2 never speaks call 1's figures ("चौदह हज़ार", three vacancies), never says the plumber job was posted, and does not reuse its details without asking. Console: call 1 has no create_job; any create_job in call 2 follows its own consent yes.

column3: Several testers called at the same time
column4: [Start 3 to 5 calls at once from the console or a campaign, each to a different test number with different inputs — e.g. New Star Garments / Helper, Star Tailors / Tailor, and one new-vacancy call with no business name] Each tester answers normally and posts one job.
column5: Each call behaves as if it were alone. (writes a real posting — use a test number and mark the posting for deletion) Pass criteria: every opening names that call's own business (or the generic owner question when none was sent); every freshness line uses that call's own role and values. Console: each create_job carries that call's own phone number and company name, never one from a parallel call.

column3: Owner asks the bot to repeat
column4: After any bot question: "क्या? फिर से बोलिए।" then, after the repeat, "थोड़ा धीरे बोलिए, समझ नहीं आया।"
column5: Bot gives the same question again (reworded or slower), without impatience, and waits for the answer. Pass criteria: the question is actually repeated both times — not skipped and not answered on the tester's behalf; no "जैसा मैंने कहा"-style remark; the call does not move on until the tester answers.
